sources.title: 40 CFR 86.1806-17 — Onboard diagnostics
sources.quote: For a 0.020 inch leak, the DTC(s) shall be a generic SAE J2012 DTC that is specific to an EVAP system very small leak (e.g., P0456, P04EE, or P04EF) or an equivalent manufacturer-specific DTC that we approve.
sources.rights: Federal regulatory text cited by link and short quotation. No SAE database licence obtained. eCFR is the authoritative but unofficial electronic CFR edition.
sources.scope: U.S. OBD regulation; MY2017 and later vehicles described in this paragraph. Not a model-specific OEM repair source.

dtc_regulatory_examples.fault_causality: A DTC reports a monitor condition, not a unique failed component.
